title: Charging Dynamics in a Distance-Modulated Planar Quantum-Battery Architecture
summary: While the spatial arrangement of individual units is essential for the physical implementation of quantum batteries, geometry-dependent interactions are rarely explicitly incorporated into existing theoretical models. To address this, we propose a planar many-body quantum-battery architecture consisting of coupled resonators. By introducing a distance-dependent function to modulate both the inter-battery coupling and tunneling, we investigate the open-system charging dynamics in the strong-coupling regime using a Redfield master-equation approach.
